name: vision-powers
description: Visualize Claude Code plugins, git diffs, and markdown docs as HTML or markdown reports with diagrams. On a capable account, HTML reports publish as claude.ai Artifacts (--local writes a local file instead). Skills: plugin-visual (plugin audit with security and architecture), diff-visual (catch up on a diff before review, with a quiz), doc-visual (diagrams per section), fact-check (verify claims against code and git history), report-manager (list, open, delete, search, refine). Reports take --format md and --lang.
